summary: Milestone 2026.09.668 completed 10 experiments, all compute-bound, totaling 7.9 wall-time minutes. The longest experiment was 'Test Qwen grounded claim proposals against independently checked source atoms' at 3.26 minutes, followed by 'Bind fourteen tasks and distinguish evidence-format failure from scientific null' at 1.35 minutes and 'Independently audit grounded decisions and delayed feedback causality' at 0.9 minutes. Task timing was reconstructed from disk mtime without intra-task sub-phase telemetry.
bottlenecks_identified: The slowest experiment 'Test Qwen grounded claim proposals against independently checked source atoms' consumed 3.26 minutes (41.3% of the 7.9 total milestone wall-time minutes), but the absence of sub-phase profiling prevents decomposing time spent in model inference versus grounding verification checks.

The top two compute-bound experiments ('Test Qwen grounded claim proposals against independently checked source atoms' at 3.26 minutes and 'Bind fourteen tasks and distinguish evidence-format failure from scientific null' at 1.35 minutes) together accounted for 4.61 of the 7.9 total wall-time minutes (58.4%) without stage-level execution traces.
The 5 slowest experiments collectively accounted for 6.68 of the 7.9 total wall-time minutes (84.6%), with durations derived via disk-mtime fallback rather than live interval event timestamps.

The GPU monitor report captures an isolated post-execution snapshot (both RTX 3090 GPUs at 4MB allocated, 0% utilization), providing no active-window accelerator utilization trace while gpu_idle_on_compute_bound_tasks is false.
No experiment records indicate concurrent multi-model execution, meaning DualGPURunner dispatch was not applicable to the tasks completed this milestone.
improvements_suggested: Introduce monotonic sub-phase timers inside compute-bound experiments—specifically claim proposal generation and grounding verification paths—to separate model inference time from validation routines.
Capture continuous in-run GPU telemetry during compute-bound executions to evaluate accelerator utilization and VRAM dynamics across active task windows.
Record model inventory and concurrency metadata in experiment execution manifests to verify DualGPURunner eligibility when multiple models are executed.
Persist structured milestone run logs with exact start and end timestamps to avoid falling back to disk-mtime timing reconstruction.
top_3_highest_leverage_actions: Instrument sub-phase duration counters in grounded claim proposal generation and independent verification stages to decompose compute overhead.
Implement continuous GPU utilization logging during compute-bound task runs to record active-window accelerator metrics.
Log model concurrency and runner dispatch decisions in experiment receipts to audit DualGPURunner usage on multi-model workloads.
meta_reflection: Across 7.9 wall-time minutes, milestone 2026.09.668 completed 10 compute-bound experiments dominated by grounded claim evaluation (3.26 minutes) and task binding validation (1.35 minutes). While the point-in-time GPU monitor snapshot showed both GPUs idle with 4MB allocated, gpu_idle_on_compute_bound_tasks is false and in-run accelerator metrics were unmeasured, with no multi-model tasks present to engage DualGPURunner. Implementing sub-phase profiling and continuous accelerator telemetry represents the highest-leverage path to isolating operational bottlenecks in subsequent milestones.
